class.name: PathPrefix
class.brief_description: The logic of one path prefix for [PathPrefixServer].

method.name: _globalize
method.description: Returns the real path for [param path]. [param path] is the canonical prefixed path, for example [code]mods://a/b.txt[/code]. Required.

method.name: _is_available
method.description: Returns [code]false[/code] if the prefix does not work on this platform or in this build. Optional, [code]true[/code] by default.

method.name: _is_read_only
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if paths with this prefix cannot be written to. Optional, [code]false[/code] by default.

method.name: _localize
method.description: Returns the canonical prefixed path for the real path [param global_path], or an empty string if it does not belong to this prefix. Optional; without it [method PathPrefixServer.localize] does not map paths to this prefix.
